sv.title: Uppgifter: Maktkamp i familjens lyximperium
sv.summary: En intern rivalitet kring vem som ska ta över LVMH-imperiet efter Bernard Arnault har blossat upp, skriver The Guardian. Detta i samband med en ny bok ges ut som beskriver spänningarna inom familjen.

en.title: Reports: Power struggle in the family's luxury empire
en.summary: An internal rivalry over who will take over the LVMH empire after Bernard Arnault has flared up, writes The Guardian. This coincides with a new book being published that describes the tensions within the family.
